sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Green Dial Chain Bracelet Watch for Women
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Make a statement with this elegant Vintage Anti-Tarnish Gold Bracelet Watch, featuring a rich green round dial and a beautifully detailed interlocking chain bracelet. The gold-tone finish, sparkling accents and deep green dial create a luxurious vintage-inspired look that feels like jewellery on your wrist.
Designed for women who love unique and elegant accessories, this watch combines the functionality of a classic timepiece with the glamour of a statement bracelet. Its intricate chain detailing makes it perfect for adding a sophisticated touch to both everyday and occasion looks.
Product Highlights
- ✨ Vintage-inspired bracelet watch
- 💛 Anti-tarnish gold-tone finish
- 💚 Elegant deep green dial
- 💎 Sparkling stone detailing on the bracelet
- 🔗 Stylish interlocking chain-link design
- ⌚ Quartz movement
- 🌸 Jewellery-inspired statement look
- 👗 Easy to style with ethnic and western outfits
- 🎁 Perfect gifting option for women
- ✨ Suitable for everyday wear and special occasions
Perfect For
College, office, casual outings, festive occasions, parties, date nights, weddings and gifting.
Care Tip: Keep away from perfumes, water, excessive sweat and harsh chemicals. Store in a dry place when not in use to help maintain the finish.
